visionShortlist.notes: Installable paired bundle in AI Pack Vault. Single-image input supported; verify model quality on the target device.
Installable paired bundle in AI Pack Vault. Single-image input supported; verify model quality on the target device.
Best Q-P1NG Pro local candidate after SmolVLM2. Validate template, mmproj artifacts and thermal behavior before installable release.
Recommended for private LAN/onion remote nodes instead of normal Android local execution.

Official model is multimodal, but the visible GGUF entry does not provide a validated mmproj artifact. Keep local Android install gated; prefer private remote node until projector packaging is verified.
Do not mix with current text-only Gemma packs. Requires explicit multimodal artifact validation.

packs.name: Q-Brain Analyst (Phi-4-mini Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Heavier English-first analyst profile for summaries, long documents and reasoning-heavy work on stronger devices.

packs.name: Q-Brain Mobile (Qwen3 1.7B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Balanced default for most Android phones in 2026. Strong multilingual chat, summaries and light agent workflows.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 2B (Q4_K_M, text)
packs.description: Qwen3.5 hybrid model for offline multilingual text chat. Text-only package; no vision projector included. Non-thinking mode is the mobile default.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 0.8B (Q4_K_M, text)
packs.description: Qwen3.5 hybrid model for offline multilingual text chat. Text-only package; no vision projector included. Non-thinking mode is the mobile default.

packs.name: Q-Brain Vision Lite (SmolVLM2 256M Q8_0)
packs.description: Compact paired Vision model for simple image questions. Limited fine-text OCR and multilingual accuracy; stronger models are available in Vision.

packs.name: Q-Brain ARM Safe (Llama 3.2 1B Q4_0_4_4)
packs.description: Universal ARM fallback profile. Safe pick when you want maximum compatibility across Android chipsets.

packs.name: Q-Brain Fast (Llama 3.2 1B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Fast multilingual helper with excellent compatibility. Good fallback when Qwen is too heavy or unavailable.

packs.name: Q-Brain Fast Pro (Llama 3.2 3B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Higher-quality Llama fallback for stronger phones. Good middle ground between tiny 1B and heavier 4B+ classes.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Safe (E2B Q3_K_S)
packs.description: Most compatible Gemma 4 E2B profile for Android phones. Lowest RAM pressure while keeping Gemma 4 reasoning, multilingual and tool-oriented behavior.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Balanced (E2B Q3_K_M)
packs.description: Balanced Gemma 4 E2B profile for mid-range and upper mid-range Android devices. Better quality than Q3_K_S with moderate RAM usage.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Plus (E2B Q4_K_S)
packs.description: Higher-quality Gemma 4 E2B profile for upper mid-range and flagship Android phones. Good compromise before Q4_K_M.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Mobile (E2B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Recommended Gemma 4 E2B text-only profile for flagship Android phones. Strong multilingual reasoning, coding, summaries and local tool orchestration.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Pro (E4B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: High-quality Gemma 4 E4B profile for 12 GB+ Android devices, tablets and local desktop-class runtimes. Not recommended as the default phone model.

packs.name: Q-Brain Lite (Qwen3 0.6B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Ultra-light multilingual offline assistant for low-RAM phones, fast prompts and emergency fallback.

packs.name: Q-Brain Pro (Qwen3 4B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Higher-quality multilingual assistant for flagship devices. Best for richer chat, summarization and light local tool orchestration.

packs.name: Q-Brain Ultra (Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Optional flagship tier for 16 GB class devices and tablets. Stronger quality, but heavier thermally and in RAM.

packs.name: Q-Brain DeepSeek R1 (8B UD-IQ2_M) [BETA]
packs.description: DeepSeek R1-0528 reasoning model distilled on Qwen3-8B. Ultra-compressed for 8 GB Android phones. Strong logical reasoning and coding with native think-mode. BETA: verify SHA256 before production use.

packs.name: Q-Brain DeepSeek R1 (8B Q3_K_M) [BETA]
packs.description: DeepSeek R1-0528 reasoning model distilled on Qwen3-8B. Balanced quality for 10-12 GB Android phones and tablets. Best reasoning-per-byte ratio for the DeepSeek R1 series on mobile. BETA: verify SHA256 before production use.

packs.name: Q-Brain Embedding (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Q8_0)
packs.description: Local sentence embedding model for Hybrid RAG retrieval, knowledge vault indexing and semantic search.

packs.name: Whisper Base (Multi)
packs.description: Standard offline engine offering an excellent balance between speed and accuracy for multilingual transcription.

packs.name: Whisper Base (English Only)
packs.description: Premium offline engine optimized exclusively for English. High accuracy.

packs.name: Whisper Tiny (English Only)
packs.description: Optimized offline engine exclusively for English voice transcription. Extremely fast.

packs.name: Whisper Tiny (Multi)
packs.description: Fast and lightweight offline tactical engine for multilingual voice transcription. Best for older devices.

packs.name: Kokoro TTS (English HD)
packs.description: Ultra-realistic state-of-the-art TTS engine for Q-Brain Pro voice mode. Outperforms traditional VITS models.
packs.unavailableReason: The declared ONNX and voice files are absent upstream. A compatible Kokoro phonemizer, token/voice bundle and runtime adapter must be validated before enabling this pack.

packs.name: Whisper Small (Multi - High Accuracy)
packs.description: High-accuracy offline transcription engine for modern flagship devices. Best for noisy environments and complex languages.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 3 (9B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Official Gemma 3 Instruct profile. Exceptional reasoning and context handling for 12GB+ RAM flagship devices.
packs.unavailableReason: The declared Gemma 3 9B repository cannot be verified. Select an available Gemma model until a compatible artifact is validated.

packs.name: Q-Brain Ultra-Lite (BitNet 2B)
packs.description: 1.58-bit ternary model for legacy devices. Requires incredibly low memory (~400MB) while maintaining coherent chat capabilities. Perfect for older fallback phones.
packs.unavailableReason: The declared 2B artifact points to an unverified 8B repository. A compatible GGUF and native quantization backend must be validated first.

packs.name: Juggernaut XL v9 (SDXL Q4_K)
packs.description: Photorealistic SDXL model optimized for mobile. Best general-purpose image generator for high-end devices.

packs.name: RealVisXL V5.0 Lightning (SDXL Q4_K)
packs.description: Ultra-fast SDXL portrait model. Uses Lightning distillation to generate high-quality images in just 4-8 steps, saving battery and time.

packs.name: Pony Diffusion V6 (SDXL Q4_K)
packs.description: The standard for stylized, anime, and illustration generation on mobile. Highly responsive to detailed prompts.
